question: Who is the author of the book ‘I Do What I Do’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Raghuram Rajan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Raghuram Rajan**

 
 
• At **Chicago Booth**, **Raghuram Rajan **holds **the position of Katherine Dusak **Miller Distinguished **Service Professor of Finance**.
 
• In the **period from September 2013 **to **September 2016**, he served as the **23rd Governor of the Reserve Bank of India**.
 
• **Dr. Rajan **served as the **International Monetary Fund's Chief Economist **and **Director of Research between 2003 and 2006**.
 
• He has a **bachelor's degree in electrical engineering from IIT Delhi**.
 
• He **graduated in 1985 and was awarded the Director's Gold Medal for being the best all-rounder student**.
 
• He was the **writer of "I Do What I Do''**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indian economist, former IAS official**, and **central banker Duvvuri Subbarao**. He was the **22nd Governor of Reserve Bank of India**, served under **Prime Minister Dr. Manmohan Singh**.
 
• **American economist Abhijit Vinayak Banerjee, **who was **born in India**, holds the **position of Ford Foundation International Professor of Economics at MIT.**
 
• **Indian economist Arvind Subramanian **previously served as the **Government of India's Chief Economic Advisor **from **16 October 2014 until 20 June 2018**. At the **Watson Institute for International and Public Affairs at Brown University, Subramanian is now a Senior Fellow**.
